newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian inflation slows to 0.2 pct in Oct 14 week.
newsitem.headline: Russian inflation slows to 0.2 pct in Oct 14 week.

text.p: Russian inflation slowed in the week ended October 14 to 0.2 percent from 0.5 percent in the previous week, the State Statistics Committee said on Thursday.
Inflation in the first 14 days of October was 0.7 percent, compared with 0.3 percent in the whole of September.
If current trends were maintained, inflation for the whole of October could be 1.5 percent.
Prices had risen 17.3 percent so far this year and could rise 22 percent for the whole year, at current rates. Inflation was 131 percent year-on-year in December 1995.
